## 4. Value Drivers & Buying Criteria

| Factor | Importance (1–5) | What Wins Them Over |
|---|---|---|
| Speed & Performance | 5 | Instant page loads (< 200ms), fast search |
| Data Security & Compliance | 5 | SOC2 compliance, SSO / SAML, audit logs |
| Self-serve Simplicity | 4 | Transparent pricing, no "Book a Demo" wall for standard tiers |
| API & Extensibility | 4 | Well-documented REST/GraphQL API, webhooks |

## 5. UI & UX Preferences

- **Density**: Prefers high-density data tables with compact rows over spacious cards.
- **Shortcuts**: Heavy user of keyboard shortcuts (`Cmd+K`, Tab navigation).
- **Theme**: Defaults to Dark Mode.
- **Microcopy**: Appreciates concise, technical accuracy over playful conversational filler.
